verdict.rationale: Basecamp documents official first-party support for operating it through ChatGPT, Claude, and AI agents via MCP, plus official Skills and a CLI for agents, so natural-language control is possible through these external AI clients. There is no documented built-in natural-language command interface, and the depth of what can be done is unspecified. Missing for 10: a native in-product natural-language command surface, documentation of which actions are controllable by natural language, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Official Basecamp support for ChatGPT, Claude, and AI agents with full MCP support.
